PRIVATE CORRESPONDENCE

The words are waiting.

Your decoded message will appear here.

01

One tiny change.

We place bits in the least significant RGB channels. Each used color channel changes by at most one level. The alpha channel stays intact.

02

Keep the original.

Send the PNG as a file. JPEG conversion, resizing, filters and social apps may erase the message. Hidden does not mean undetectable.

03

You hold the key.

Without a password, anyone with Pixel Letter can read it. With one, the message is encrypted. No passwords, messages or images are stored by this app.
